title: 【老闆急件】先備份並清空既有任務池，改為直接執行；全面重構派工底層
description: 老闆於 Telegram msg 1329 明確指示：第一步先對 storage/next_tasks.json 做可回復備份，之後清空既有任務；暫停把工作送進任務池，所有工作改為直接執行。接著第一個直接執行的工作是全面盤點並重構整個派工／認領／commit／殘留收斂底層，消除無人認領、無法 commit、任務池堵塞與舊機制殘留。這是 user-assigned P1 急件；須直接開工，不可只寫計畫或再拆成一般排隊單。依五步結案 gate：live 證據、根因層級、底層重構、回歸與下游回讀、制度化寫回；未全過只能標 contained。操作含清空任務池，務必先建立可驗證備份並保留回復路徑。完成後以 Telegram 回報短結論與可查證證據。
containment_evidence: Program commit 15 safe reconcile production ownership slice is root_cause_fixed_and_verified: hourly feed-sync safe upserts now use one exact feed byte snapshot and route through the generation-owned immutable batch, private payload store, WorkItem, EffectRequest/outbox, primary lease, and typed settlement. Production rehearsal completed legacy/1 -> operations_core/2 -> legacy/3 exact rollback -> operations_core/4; current read-back shows work succeeded, effect/outbox delivered, local/Supabase 14/14 with drift 0. The tracked-snapshot selected suite passes 91/91 including the full 47-case PostgreSQL contract file, and the final schedule-equivalent command exits 0. Follow-up failure injections also closed the single and batch authority replacement windows between provider read-back and upsert: each actual mutation now revalidates the original lease epoch, and replacement yields zero writes and zero settlement with 82 adjacent tests passing. The overall umbrella remains contained because destructive delete lacks its separate formal effect/owner/rollback and program commit 34 lacks a physical two-Mac receipt pair.
next_direct_step: Design the destructive publisher-delete family as a separate guarded EffectRequest/owner with floor, cap, dump, explicit authorization, and exact rollback; run live rollback plus convergence read-back without adding delete authority to the unattended hourly safe job. Separately collect the two-physical-Mac authority receipt pair for program commit 34.
latest_checkpoint: Safe reconcile remains production-owned at operations_core/4. Post-cutover failure injections replaced the Primary Authority epoch while single and batch provider read-back was in flight; both formal callers now revalidate the original lease immediately before every actual upsert, so stale attempts perform zero projection writes and no settlement. Owned callers, effects, rehearsals, feed-sync and CLI adjacent suites pass 82/82. Safe slice root_cause_fixed_and_verified; destructive delete and physical two-Mac evidence keep the broader program contained.
